about: Camps listed twice (reviewed pairs from scripts/camps/find-duplicates.ts). `duplicates`: each `drop` camp_key is excluded from queryCamps (lib/db/queries/camps.ts), so it leaves the directory, sitemap, exports, calendars and feed events, and its page redirects to the `keep` camp's. Keep the card from the organization that runs the camp; when both are equally official, the richer one. `distinct`: pairs reviewed and judged different camps, so a re-run marks them decided.
